flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/index.html then Search for rice, add it to cart and reach the checkout page.
Fail if it takes longer than 30 seconds.

remark:
agent_info: Screenshot failed: TimeoutError: screenshot: Timeout 60000ms exceeded.
Call log:

summary:
The automation was set to take a screenshot after opening the page, and that screenshot waited for page fonts to finish. The font requests did not complete, so the screenshot timed out after 60 seconds.
Change the test screenshot setting so it does not wait indefinitely for fonts, or use a short bounded wait and continue the shopping flow when optional font loading is unfinished.
one_liner: The run stopped because its screenshot tool waited for fonts that never finished loading, before it performed any shopping actions.

verdict.root_cause: The automation was set to take a screenshot after opening the page, and that screenshot waited for page fonts to finish. The font requests did not complete, so the screenshot timed out after 60 seconds.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not click the wrong item or fail to follow the shopping flow; it never had an opportunity to act because the automation's mandatory screenshot capture blocked immediately after navigation. This is a test/automation configuration failure rather than evidence that the storefront's search, cart, or checkout is broken.
verdict.bug_title: Screenshot capture blocks on unfinished font loading
verdict.suggestion: Change the test screenshot setting so it does not wait indefinitely for fonts, or use a short bounded wait and continue the shopping flow when optional font loading is unfinished.
